cases.name: PH1-empty-original-stored-as-TEXT
cases.sql: UPDATE member_objects SET bytes=CAST(x'' AS TEXT) WHERE length(bytes)=0

cases.name: PH3-empty-candidate-TEXT
cases.sql: UPDATE restored_objects SET bytes=CAST(x'' AS TEXT)

cases.name: PH4-empty-original-rewritten-as-zeroblob0
cases.sql: UPDATE member_objects SET bytes=zeroblob(0) WHERE length(bytes)=0

cases.name: PH5-nonempty-original-truncated-to-empty-after-signing
cases.sql: UPDATE member_objects SET bytes=x'' WHERE length(bytes)>0 AND cid=(SELECT min(cid) FROM member_objects WHERE length(bytes)>0)

cases.name: PH6-empty-original-replaced-by-one-byte
cases.sql: UPDATE member_objects SET bytes=x'00' WHERE length(bytes)=0
